title: TADPOLE Historical-Method Fidelity Repair and Reproduction
root_fallback_reason: OSSFS errno 5 Input/output error during directory creation

isolated_method_streams.reason: Internal fixed source stream(s), independent of the single experimental seed 0.

randomness.fold_initialization: Python, NumPy, PyTorch CPU and all CUDA streams reset to experimental seed 0 once at the start of each independent fold. Resume restores serialized RNG states. G1 and G2 retain original registration and initialization with physical no-PEN differences; G3 and G4 use the same model/optimizer/pairs/RNG state across the matched 10-epoch warmup.

G1_E28_E0.gfr_fusion: Historical second-modality overwrite, followed by addition of modalities 3 through 6.

G2_E43_1_E00.gfr_fusion: Historical second-modality overwrite, followed by addition of modalities 3 through 6.

G3_E74_4_G2.graph: signed DeltaA in unified graph; clamp_min(DeltaA,0) only in direct residual
G3_E74_4_G2.candidate_adaptation: All six retain historical non-CORR original support, mutual top-12 and E53.3 sparse anchor fallback. Confidence <= .45 or >= .55, temperature 1.0, gate initial probability .1 and non-CORR scale .01.
G3_E74_4_G2.warmup: TADPOLE-only E51/E53.3/E61 epoch 1–10 with original graph and all three relation terms for G3 and G4. State_dict, base/CAM/DARG optimizer, ordered pair, and complete RNG SHA-256 recorded per fold.
G3_E74_4_G2.gfr_fusion: Historical E74 additive GCN and bounded direct disease messages; baseline second-modality overwrite is specific to G1/G2.

G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.loss: Historical DARG total plus canonical SCMR objectives and family-specific optimizer application. Full/off CE, true-strongest margin gain, guard, calibration guidance, regularization and source budget.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.spectrum: Train-only CAM240. Eight PCA and eight orthogonal disease directions from empirical-prior-weighted squared pairwise class-conditional covariance differences, with historical whitening and 16 spectral tokens.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.classes: NC/MCI/AD retained as three conditional Gaussian classes
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.gaussian_banks: One all-outer-train and five StratifiedKFold leave-bank banks, random_state=824250+fold. Three conditional classes, double deletion comparison banks, and train-only cross-fitted class-balanced calibration.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.prompts: canonical E82.4.6-G2 fixed eight-text medical and anonymous embeddings, SHA verified
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.gradient_budget: Canonical SCMR apply_budget plus optimizer_measurements. Shared families GFR/DARG/CAM/head use the historical float64 tangent projection of q=grad(F-O) against b and exact cast-aware 0.001 norm budget. New-family controls follow the source optimizer. Zero residual and real optimizer step are verified.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.ema: Initialize from matching outer-train warmup. Train-only class mean/second-moment state advances from native post-eval CAM once per epoch. Best stores the bank for the selected eval; Latest stores the advanced bank.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.abide_fold8: not copied; no patient overlap or ABIDE checkpoint is used
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.candidate_adaptation: Six historical non-CORR branches. Keep original supported off-diagonal edges, mutual Top-12, 0.55/0.45 thresholds and temperature 1.0. Uniform fixed scale uses historical non-CORR 0.01. Reweight strength 0.8; adaptive gate initialization sigmoid=0.1 and bounded direct residual multiplier 0.02.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.warmup: TADPOLE-only E51/E53.3/E61 epoch 1–10 with original graph and all three relation terms for G3 and G4. State_dict, base/CAM/DARG optimizer, ordered pair, and complete RNG SHA-256 recorded per fold.

three_class_adaptation.inference: top two native-logit classes oriented AD>MCI>NC, using the same LLR, Jacobian and calibration direction; no outer-test labels
three_class_adaptation.training: balanced over three classes, true-class minus strongest competitor, route pair guidance when the true class belongs to the selected contrast

G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.gfr_fusion: Historical E74 additive GCN and bounded direct disease messages; baseline second-modality overwrite is specific to G1/G2.
G4_E82_4_6_10_G1.class_routing: The two highest native-logit classes are oriented by disease stage. Three independent reference classes; no true test label needed. Training margin is true class minus strongest competitor. Signed guidance skips rows whose true class lies outside the routed pair.

training.checkpoint_selection: first strict ACC maximum on val_idx == test_idx
training.auc: macro one-vs-rest ROC AUC computed from hard one-hot predicted labels, matching original model.py
training.supporting_outputs: three-class probabilities and hard predictions are retained for replay

optimizer_priority.base_learning_rate: paper TADPOLE 0.012 overrides source ABIDE 0.0038 for all groups
optimizer_priority.base_weight_decay: paper silent: author base default 0.0036 for G1/G2, E61/E74 0.11 for G3/G4
optimizer_priority.method_specific: archived DARG and DPSL per-family AdamW

training.resume: Latest restores model, optimizer, RNG, EMA and progress; independent replay verifies completed folds before skipping

execution_events.event: The method audit matrix documentation changed during the first batch
execution_events.affected_folds: All four groups folds 8-10, blocked before an optimizer step
execution_events.recovery: Revalidated the unchanged training code and preflight, launched the remaining 12 folds only

training.early_stop_logic: first strict ACC improvement resets wait; stop when wait > 200 or 450 epoch cap.

base_hyperparameters.priority: TADPOLE paper base hidden/head/layer/dropout/alpha/LR, source-chain graph and optimizer controls. E61 base lr=.0038 is replaced by .012 for both G3 and G4. E61 base Adam decay .11 and DARG Opt .001/.01 are retained. G1/G2 retain base source .0036 weight decay.
